readDenyFileToolProbe.limits: One sample per case on one model and CLI version with built-in file tools only. Shell, interpreter, and MCP access, other permission modes and models, and the version where the behavior began were not tested.

permissions.observation: Edit rules apply to all built-in tools that edit files; Read deny rules are applied best-effort to built-in tools that read files. The page does not state that Read deny rules refuse Edit or Write.

documentationObservations.readDenyVersionClaim: No changelog entry for 2.1.208 or 2.1.228 states that Read deny rules cover Edit or Write; the 2.1.228 entry concerns Write overwriting an unread file.
